description: This source file contains the implementation of the 'Login' feature in the Conduit application, including command validation and request handling logic for user login functionality.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Contains the nested classes related to user login: UserData, Command, CommandValidator, and Handler.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the login command by verifying user credentials, generating a JWT token upon successful authentication, and returning a user envelope.
